notes: SR116 Maisons du Monde BE (BE/nl). Access route identical to bs116/na116. Main nav has a 'KOOPJES' (Bargains/Deals) top-level item - NOT 'Outlet' or 'Opruiming' as such. Its dropdown lists 5 entries: (1) 'Up to -15% on all your purchases for the new season*' -> generic site-wide percent-off promo, temporary/seasonal, excluded per Sale-vs-Clearance rule; (2) 'Up to -20% on all our chair bestsellers*' -> category-specific temporary percent-off promo, excluded; (3) 'Up to -20% on all home textiles*' -> category-specific temporary percent-off promo, excluded; (4) 'Enjoy great deals' -> links to /edito/code-promo-maisons-du-monde, an editorial promo-code explainer page with no product grid, excluded; (5) 'Up to -50% on our last items*' (nav card title attribute: 'Tot -50% op onze laatste stuks*' = 'Up to -50% on our last pieces/items*') -> links to /c/voordeel-deals-... , a genuine PLP titled 'Voordeel Deals' (Value/Bargain Deals) with 114 products, filterable like any category page, no further sub-structure (no child chips). This is the strongest clearance-shaped candidate: 'laatste stuks' (last pieces/items) signals end-of-line/limited-final-stock merchandising rather than a purely temporary seasonal discount campaign, matching the brief's 'Last Chance'/'End of Line' target-term family. However the page's own on-page heading/breadcrumb label is the generic 'Voordeel Deals' (Bargain Deals), not an explicit 'Outlet'/'Opruiming'/'Clearance' word, so it is recorded with a MANUAL REVIEW flag per the brief's ambiguous-sale-vs-clearance instruction rather than either being silently excluded or silently accepted as clean Clearance. Confirmed via full nav sweep (KOOPJES, NIEUW, BESTSELLERS, PRODUCTEN, WOONRUIMTES, INTERIEURIDEEEN, CADEAUKAART - none other named Outlet/Opruiming) and the site's own search for 'outlet', which returned non-discriminating fuzzy substring matches unrelated to outlet/clearance (e.g. products containing 'letters') - consistent with the brief's warning that a zero/non-discriminating site search is not proof of absence, so nav-based investigation was treated as authoritative. No dedicated Outlet or Opruiming PLP exists on this site as far as could be determined.
